subject.title: fix(agent): duplicate same-session turn when the gateway connection drops after accepting a run

question: Should this PR land as the narrow fresh-session accepted-disconnect fix, or should accepted disconnect recovery wait for a reattach-first design?
rationale: The code path is a valid bug fix, but the remaining choice is user-visible fallback policy: keep recook-first on an isolated session now, or delay for the broader authoritative-result recovery proposal.

options.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
options.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run fallback boundary for this edge case and keep reattach-first recovery tracked separately.

options.title: Fold in reattach-first recovery
options.body: Delay merge and require this PR to wait for the accepted gateway run before falling back to a second local run.

options.title: Pause until policy is decided
options.body: Keep the branch open without merging if maintainers do not want either recook-first or reattach-first behavior yet.

recommendation.title: Land narrow fresh-session fix
recommendation.body: Accept the existing timeout-style two-run fallback boundary for this edge case and keep reattach-first recovery tracked separately.

likelyOwner.reason: This contributor has the strongest recent history on the CLI gateway dispatch and timeout fallback paths touched by the product choice.
